trials.instruction: Create an ORIGINAL reusable PURE DART module named aivexus_stable_unique for Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. All signed integers are valid, including zero, negative values and duplicates; an empty list returns an empty list. Examples: [3,3,-1,3,2,-1,0,2,0] => [3,-1,2,0]; [5,5,5] => [5]; [] => [].
